title: Paloma and the Wolf Again
author: Freya Eriksen
blurb: Marguerite Voss, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
